notes:
- **Edit info no longer moves a title out of its section.** If a title sat in a
  section the editor didn't list — Documentary, say — opening **Edit info**
  showed "TV Show" instead, so saving a small change (a typo, a new poster)
  quietly filed the title under TV Shows and moved its files on the server. The
  editor now shows the section the title is actually in, and leaves it alone
  unless you change it yourself.
